content.text:
Make a game that, if everyone played it, would improve the world for the greatest number of people.

Build this as a complete, playable Godot 4.7.2 project in the current directory.
- Use the gl_compatibility renderer, and don't enable thread support (it must run as a web export).
- Set a main scene in project.godot. Add a short README.md with run instructions.
- Keep it self-contained: no downloads, external assets or plugins.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory. Don't export the project; that happens afterwards.
- Check it loads: run `godot --headless --path . --editor --quit` and fix any errors.
- End your final message with a line starting with `Blurb:`, then one to three sentences in the third
  person describing what you made for a visitor who will see it on the site: name the work if it has a
  name, and say what it is and what it does or is about. No file names, commands, instructions or claims
  about tests. For example: "Blurb: Ripple is a game that teaches players to spot online misinformation."
I’ll build a game about neighbors working together to restore essential services during a heat wave, then verify that the Godot project loads and plays.

from heapq import heappush,heappop
maps=[
([\"###=p##=pp##\",\"#S=W..A===B#\",\"#.#.##.#.#.#\",\"#==.C..===.#\",\"pp=#.##=.p##\",\"#..=..#=..D#\",\"#.#.##p#.=~~\",\"p=====...p~~\"],[1,1,2,1]),
([\"###=p##=pp##\",\"#S=W..A===B#\",\"#.#.##.#.#.#\",\"#==E...===.#\",\"pp=#C##=.p##\",\"#..=..#=W.D#\",\"#.#.##p#.=~~\",\"p=====...p~~\"],[1,2,1,2,1]),
([\"###=p##=pp##\",\"#S=W..A===B#\",\"#.#.##.#.#.#\",\"#==E...===.#\",\"pp=#C##=.p##\",\"#F.=..#=..D#\",\"#.#.##p#.=~~\",\"p=====...p~~\"],[1,2,2,1,1,1])]
for board,needs in maps:
 start=next((x,y) for y,row in enumerate(board) for x,c in enumerate(row) if c=='S')
 q=[(0,start,0,0,[])]; done=set()
 while q:
  cost,p,n,mask,path=heappop(q)
  if (p,n,mask) in done: continue
  done.add((p,n,mask))
  if mask==(1<<len(needs))-1: print(cost,[(pos,t) for pos,t in path if t]); break
  for a,b in [(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)]:
   x,y=p[0]+a,p[1]+b
   if not(0<=x<12 and 0<=y<8): continue
   t=board[y][x]
   if t in '#p~': continue
   m=mask
   steps=1 if t in '=SW' or (t.isalpha() and mask>>(ord(t)-65)&1) else 2
   w=3 if t=='W' else n
   event=t if t=='W' and n<3 else ''
   if t not in '=SW.' and not(mask>>(ord(t)-65)&1) and w>=needs[ord(t)-65]:
    m|=1<<(ord(t)-65);w-=needs[ord(t)-65];event=t
   heappush(q,(cost+steps,(x,y),w,m,path+[((x,y),event)]))
PY"

cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# The Cool Route

A short routing game about checking in on neighbors during a heat wave. Deliver water to every household across three rounds before daylight runs out.

## Run

Open this directory in Godot 4.7.2 and press **F6** with the main scene open, or press **F5** from anywhere in the editor. You can also run "'`godot --path .` from this directory.

Click or tap a map tile or a household in the list to follow a route. Arrow keys and WASD move one tile at a time. Fountains refill your three-bottle carrier. Shade uses one unit of daylight per tile and sun uses two. Households open shaded stops after you deliver their water.

Press **Z** to undo a route, **R** to restart the current day, or **H** to open the field guide. The help and day controls also work by mouse or touch.

Art and sound are generated in Godot. The project uses the Compatibility renderer and runs on a single thread.
EOF
cat > .gitignore <<'"'EOF'
.godot/
EOF"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat > .godot/verify_game.gd <<'EOF'
extends SceneTree

var game: Node2D
var failed := false


func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred(\"run\")


func expect(condition: bool, message: String) -> void:
	if not condition:
		failed = true
		printerr(message)


func run() -> void:
	game = load(\"res://main.tscn\").instantiate()
	root.add_child(game)
	await process_frame
	if not DisplayServer.get_name() == \"headless\":
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(\"res://.godot/initial.png\")
	var maps := [
		[Vector2i(3, 1), Vector2i(4, 3), Vector2i(3, 1), Vector2i(6, 1), Vector2i(10, 1), Vector2i(10, 5)],
		[Vector2i(3, 1), Vector2i(3, 3), Vector2i(4, 4), Vector2i(3, 1), Vector2i(6, 1), Vector2i(10, 1), Vector2i(8, 5), Vector2i(10, 5)],
		[Vector2i(3, 1), Vector2i(3, 3), Vector2i(1, 5), Vector2i(3, 1), Vector2i(6, 1), Vector2i(10, 1), Vector2i(3, 1), Vector2i(4, 4), Vector2i(10, 5)]
	]
	game.click(game.cell_center(Vector2i(3, 1)))
	game.toggle_guide()
	game._process(3.0)
	expect(game.water == 0, \"Guide should pause walking\")
	game.toggle_guide()
	game._process(3.0)
	expect(game.water == 3 and game.daylight == 47, \"Refilling should use 2 daylight\")
	game.undo_route()
	expect(game.water == 0 and game.daylight == 49, \"Undo should restore first move\")
	for day_routes in maps:
		for cell in day_routes:
			game.click(game.cell_center(cell))
			game._process(3.0)
		print(\"Day %d: %d/%d, %d daylight remaining\" % [
			game.day + 1, game.delivered.size(), game.needs.size(), game.daylight
		])
		expect(game.result == \"complete\", \"Completion for day %d\" % (game.day + 1))
		game.advance()
	expect(game.result == \"campaign\", \"Campaign completion\")
	if not DisplayServer.get_name() == \"headless\":
		await process_frame
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(\"res://.godot/complete.png\")
	game.advance()
	expect(game.day == 0 and game.delivered.is_empty() and game.daylight == 49, \"Play again\")
	game.daylight = 1
	game.go(Vector2i(2, 1), true)
	game._process(3.0)
	expect(game.result == \"time\", \"Time out\")
	game.undo_route()
	expect(game.daylight == 1 and game.result.is_empty(), \"Undo a failed route\")
	game.load_day(0)
	expect(game.daylight == 49 and game.history.is_empty(), \"Restart\")
	quit(1 if failed else 0)
EOF
godot --headless --path . --script .godot/verify_game.gd"

Built **The Cool Route**, a complete, self-contained Godot 4.7.2 game. It uses the Compatibility renderer with thread support disabled. Run instructions are in [README.md](README.md).

The required headless editor check passed, and I verified that all three rounds are playable through completion.

Blurb: The Cool Route is a neighborhood routing game about looking after one another during a heat wave. Players deliver water, seek out shaded streets, and help households open shaded stops that make the next day’s rounds easier.
